text.tspan: Add colour everywhere! (The text 'Add colour' is for reference and doesn't print.) Then add your
'fortunes' - pictures/text - into the empty triangles. When you are happy with your design:
1. Cut out the main square and fold in half horizontally and vertically
2. Turn the paper over to show the blank side and fold each of the corners into the centre
3. Turn the paper over so you can see the fortunes and fold each corner into the centre
4. Fold the paper along the horizontal and vertical, folding the numbers towards each other
5. Gently push your fingers into the pockets you have created to make four pyramids
